# MarketSync

> MarketSync is a dealership operating system and growth platform for car dealerships in
> Canada and the United States. It connects three pillars: MarketSync Digital to grow
> customer demand, DealerOS to run the store, and Intelligence to measure what happened.
> Free trials run 7 days for individual products, 14 days for marketing suites, and
> 30 days for MarketSync Digital and DealerOS.

## How this file is maintained

Prices are not listed here. They change per product, per currency and per plan, and a
duplicated number goes stale silently. The pricing page below is the single canonical
source; every figure a person or model needs is there.

## The three pillars

- **MarketSync Digital** — the demand side: dealership website, SEO, AI Customer Agent,
  social, video and campaigns, sold as one package.
- **DealerOS** — the operating side: sales CRM, inventory intelligence, deal desk and F&I,
  service and parts, accounting and commissions, a dealer website, and executive
  reporting. Sold as Core, Pro and Complete.
- **Intelligence** — reporting and attribution across both.

## Products

- [DealerOS](https://marketsync.link/dealer-os.html): Runs the whole store from one login
  — sales CRM, inventory intelligence, deal desk and F&I, service and parts, accounting,
  commissions, a dealer website and executive reporting.
- [MarketSync Digital](https://marketsync.link/marketsync-digital.html): The full demand
  package — website, SEO, AI Customer Agent, social, video and campaigns.
- [Marketing suites](https://marketsync.link/marketing-suites.html): Sales Marketing,
  Service Marketing and Complete Marketing bundles.
- [Dealer Website](https://marketsync.link/dealer-website.html): Drag-and-drop dealership
  website with live inventory, self-building VIN pages, model and offer pages, lead forms
  wired to the CRM, an AI sales chat, SEO, and a custom domain on Cloudflare.
- [AI Customer Agent](https://marketsync.link/ai-chatbot.html): A customer-facing AI
  salesperson on the dealership website. Answers questions, shows live vehicle cards from
  real inventory, books the appointment and captures the lead. Formerly the AI ChatBot.
- [Discoverability](https://marketsync.link/discoverability.html): Crawls the live public
  dealership website, turns what it finds into evidence-backed findings, fixes what is safe
  to fix, and validates each fix against the public page. Reports Quality and Evidence
  Coverage separately and never counts synthetic or missing provider data as measured.
  Included with MarketSync SEO, MarketSync Digital and DealerOS Complete.
- [MarketSync SEO](https://marketsync.link/marketsync-seo.html): Automotive AI SEO — a
  daily audit, a safe auto-fix engine, local and AutoDealer schema, inventory SEO
  lifecycle rules, competitor and keyword tracking, AI-search readiness, and CRM revenue
  attribution.
- [Design Studio](https://marketsync.link/design-studio.html): Dealership design workspace
  for branded graphics, social assets and marketing collateral, with AI generation and a
  social scheduler built in. The former standalone Social Scheduler is now part of it.
- [Video](https://marketsync.link/video-studio.html): Vehicle walkaround recording,
  branded video overlays, and video email and SMS messaging.
- [Campaigns](https://marketsync.link/campaigns.html): Targeted email and SMS marketing
  with intelligent audience segmentation.
- [Facebook AutoPoster](https://marketsync.link/facebook-marketplace-poster.html): Turns
  dealership inventory into Facebook Marketplace listings in one click, with a sales
  leaderboard. Sold for an individual salesperson or for a dealership sales team. A human
  always clicks Post — MarketSync does not auto-post.
- [Intelligence](https://marketsync.link/intelligence.html): Reporting and attribution
  across the dealership.

## Who it is for

Franchise and independent car dealerships in Canada and the United States, and individual
sales representatives whose dealership has not adopted a platform yet.
